name: Mizukami Maria
source:
A girl from an ordinary family, the youngest of three siblings
She speaks in a sweet tone, love Hello Kitty and other cute things.
She is a spoiled child because she always had people by her side to protect her, such as her father.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
